model.name: TsToModel.generate
model.description: R32.2 TS->M1 generator: generate(files, opts):{units, wrote, removed} walks each SourceFile (ts.forEachChild), computes the stable identity key sourceFile::qualifiedName, derives a deterministic v4-shaped uuid, builds the M1 ModelElement (metaLevel M1, kind, name, multi-facet instanceOf [UmlX, ts-X-code], members[] composition, relatesTo[] typed relationships) and ScenarioIndex.put (re-binds if the uuid exists). Idempotent 0-churn re-run (deterministic uuid, R31.13 discipline); reconcile removes elements absent from source. Post-gen ModelValidator.validate(generated)=0. Built on the R32.1 foundation (no fork). Architect design fa25b8b45; scenario-first IMPL-MINT (no self-mint, #126) - the [impl:uuid] marker lands on the generate() decl @ src/ts/scenario/TsToModel.ts:97 (name-matches 'generate').
